context: You and two tieflings have come upon Lae'zel, a hostile-looking githyanki trapped in a cage; the pair are arguing over whether to secure her or leave her be. Damays wants to take her back to their grove/camp to keep an eye on her, citing a past incident in which a gith or githyanki slaughtered Zorru’s squad and warning that goblins might ally with her. Nymessa prefers to leave Lae'zel and continue on toward Baldur’s Gate, wanting no part of the trouble. If present, Shadowheart will caution the party not to trust githyanki, and the scene can escalate quickly — Lae'zel is proud and dangerous and may not go quietly, possibly leading to combat.
